integrity: Proof self-contained except cited classical Berwald inequality. Finite numerical checks are noncertifying. No authorship or independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: For each fixed planar convex K only. No uniform error rate, finite-compression inequality, higher-dimensional law, or independent validation. Langford (1969) accessible abstract but complete text inaccessible; historical priority remains open.
title: Fifth-chord-moment law for acute triangles in thin convex bodies
